expected_ambiguities: Behaviour is not specified when a single request sets both an outlook and a watch.
It is not stated whether aged_watch is computed against the watch start date or the last review date.

test_cases.title: Set each valid outlook value
preconditions: Issuer ISS-4001 has active MOODYS rating A3 with no watch
steps: Set outlook to POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, STABLE and DEVELOPING in turn
test_cases.expected_result: Each value is accepted and stored.

test_cases.title: Reject an invalid outlook value
preconditions: Issuer ISS-4001 has active MOODYS rating A3

test_cases.title: Set each valid watch value
preconditions: Issuer ISS-4002 has active FITCH rating BBB with outlook STABLE
steps: Set watch to WATCH_POSITIVE, WATCH_NEGATIVE and WATCH_DEVELOPING in turn

test_cases.title: Reject a watch without a direction
preconditions: Issuer ISS-4002 has active FITCH rating BBB

test_cases.title: Placing a rating on watch clears the outlook
preconditions: Issuer ISS-4003 has MOODYS rating Baa3 with outlook NEGATIVE

test_cases.title: Reject removing a watch without an outlook
preconditions: Issuer ISS-4003 is on WATCH_NEGATIVE with no outlook
steps: Remove the watch without supplying an outlook
test_cases.expected_result: Rejected with OUTLOOK_REQUIRED; watch remains WATCH_NEGATIVE.

test_cases.title: Remove a watch together with a new outlook
steps: Remove the watch and set outlook STABLE in the same request

test_cases.title: Reject outlook/watch on defaulted ratings and status codes
preconditions: Issuers with FITCH RD, FITCH D and MOODYS WR exist
steps: Set outlook STABLE on the RD rating
Set watch WATCH_POSITIVE on the D rating
Set outlook POSITIVE on the WR entry

test_cases.title: aged_watch flips after 90 days
preconditions: Two ratings placed on watch 90 and 91 calendar days ago respectively
